description: Nostrion: Meet Your Future Employer Nostrion builds a sovereign AI platform for organizations that work with sensitive data and operate under strict regulatory and security requirements. We enable companies to adopt AI without relying on public AI platforms, giving them full control over their data, models, workflows, and compliance. Our platform is designed for high-trust environments where reliability, explainability, scalability, usability, and auditability are essential. At Nostrion, we combine strong product thinking with deep technical execution to build AI systems that professionals can rely on every day. As AI becomes part of critical business workflows, the challenge is no longer only technical. It is about turning complex customer needs, regulatory requirements, and industry-specific workflows into a product that is scalable, usable, trusted, and commercially valuable. What Does Nostrion Offer You? You will join a highly ambitious and focused team where ownership, autonomy, and product quality are central. We work in a hands-on, product-driven environment with short communication lines and a strong bias toward execution. You will have direct influence on the product roadmap, platform direction, customer use cases, and the long-term development of Nostrion’s sovereign AI platform. Nostrion offers a competitive salary, attractive employment conditions, and the opportunity to help shape a company building at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, compliance, and enterprise software. This is an opportunity to build a product that moves beyond demos and isolated pilots. You will help define which customer problems deserve to become scalable platform capabilities and ensure that the product develops in a way that supports both real customer value and long-term platform growth. Your Role As Product Manager at Nostrion, you own the product roadmap and help translate market needs, customer requirements, and vertical-specific use cases into scalable platform features. You work at the intersection of business, technology, users, and delivery. Your role is to understand customer problems deeply, define what should be built, and ensure the team does not fall into the trap of over-customization or one-off proof of concept development. You help turn vertical solutions into reusable product capabilities. You structure requirements, prioritize features, validate assumptions, and make sure the product evolves in a way that supports both customer value and platform scalability. You are responsible for creating clarity in a complex environment. You separate real product needs from customer-specific noise, define what matters most, and help the team make sharp product decisions. You work closely with technical teams to translate business requirements into clear priorities, practical specifications, and product outcomes that can be built, tested, and improved. You also play an important role in product discovery and validation. You work with customers, users, Forward Deployment Engineers, AI Engineers, and platform teams to understand what is working, what is missing, and where the platform should go next. Your focus is not just on delivering features, but on building a product that can scale across customers, industries, and use cases. What Do You Bring? You have a strong quantitative profile, You have at least 3 years of experience in product management, product ownership, consulting, venture building, business analysis, or a similar role where you have tackled complex problems with clear ownership. You are analytical, structured, and comfortable working with ambiguity. You can quickly understand complex business problems, break them down into clear requirements, and translate them into product decisions that technical teams can act on. You understand that not every customer request should become a product feature. You are able to challenge assumptions, validate needs, and distinguish between one-off customization and scalable platform value. You think in systems, trade-offs, user journeys, business impact, and long-term product architecture. You are comfortable working closely with technical teams and can communicate clearly with engineers, AI specialists, designers, customers, and business stakeholders. You do not need to be the deepest technical expert in the room, but you do need to understand enough to make informed product decisions and ask the right questions. Experience with AI products, enterprise software, UI/UX, regulated industries, workflow automation, data-driven platforms, compliance-heavy environments, or customer-facing product implementation is a strong plus. You care about building products that are not only technically impressive, but also adopted, trusted, and valuable in real business environments. Your Team You work directly with the CTO, Tech Lead, AI Engineers, Forward Deployment Engineers, UX/UI, and customers. You are the bridge between vertical market needs and the scalable product platform Nostrion is building. You help translate signals from the market and from customer projects into a clear product roadmap. You work with engineering to make sure product decisions are feasible and scalable, and with customer-facing teams to ensure the platform solves real problems in a way that can be repeated. As part of the Nostrion team, you play a key role in shaping how sovereign AI becomes a practical, trusted, and scalable product for organizations that operate in complex and regulated environments. Interested? If this sounds like the kind of role you are looking for, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and we would be happy to tell you more about Nostrion, the team, and what we are building.

description: Wil jij als Business Analist werken aan uitdagende projecten voor vooruitstrevende klanten en onze Business, IT & Data-cel versterken? Solliciteer nu en ontdek jouw mogelijkheden als Employeneur! Over de rol: Stel je voor: het is maandag. Overdag werk je aan een uitdagend project bij een klant in de energiesector. Je analyseert hun bedrijfsprocessen en gebruikt jouw kennis van BPMN en requirements engineering om grip te krijgen op hun digitale transformatie. ’s Middags bel je kort met een collega die tegen een probleem aanloopt bij zijn opdracht. Dankzij jouw ervaring met data governance en procesontwerp kun je hem snel verder helpen. Dat is de kracht van samenwerken binnen onze Business, IT & Data-cel: kennis delen, elkaar versterken. En dan op donderdag, is het tijd voor de kwartaal meeting. Samen met je collega’s van de cel bespreek je de voortgang. Wat gaat goed? Waar liggen kansen? Onder het genot van een hapje en een drankje ontstaan de beste ideeën voor de verdere ontwikkeling van onze cel. Ondertussen voel je je geen externe consultant, maar echt onderdeel van een hecht team dat groeit en bouwt. Een week eerder zat je nog bij ons op kantoor voor een training. Je koos zelf: wordt het BISL? Agile? DAMA DM-BOK? Of toch een BCS Business Analysis-certificering? Het is jouw opleidingsbudget – jij bepaalt waar je in groeit. Want bij TMC draait het om jou, jouw ambities en jouw ontwikkeling. Wat ga je inhoudelijk doen? Je gaat aan de slag bij uitdagende en vernieuwende projecten bij onze opdrachtgevers! Samen gaan we voor jou op zoek naar een passende opdracht bij een werkgever waar je altijd al graag had willen werken. Er wordt veel tijd besteed aan wat jij wilt en wat jij belangrijk vindt. Bij TMC ben echt onderdeel van het team. Zo zorgen we ervoor dat je altijd op een geschikte positie terecht komt. Je gaat aan de slag bij uitdagende en vernieuwende projecten bij onze opdrachtgevers! Hoe ziet jouw werk eruit? Je analyseert bedrijfsprocessen en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeterkansen; Je haalt requirements op bij stakeholders en vertaalt deze naar heldere User Stories en Use Cases; Je werkt met modellen zoals BPMN en gebruikt tooling om processen te visualiseren; Je implementeert oplossingen die direct impact maken bij onze relaties; Je helpt collega's verder door jouw kennis te delen en samen te sparren over complexe vraagstukken; Je neemt actief deel aan onze Business, IT en Data cel, inclusief onze kwartaal meetings, trainingen en andere evenementen. Wie ben jij? Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding. Een natuurlijke gave om te schakelen tussen Business en IT. Ondernemerschap en nieuwsgierigheid: jij zoekt altijd naar de ‘waarom’ achter een probleem. Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen. Ervaring met procesmodellering, requirements engineering en Agile Wie zijn wij? Bij TMC in Noord-Oost Nederland geloven we in de kracht van ondernemende mensen. Mensen die niet alleen hun vak verstaan, maar ook willen bouwen – aan organisaties, aan elkaar, en aan zichzelf. Onze missie? Een hecht team vormen van professionals die bruggen slaan tussen bedrijfsprocessen en informatietechnologie. Geen standaardoplossingen, maar maatwerk door mensen met lef, visie en eigenaarschap. In dit team sta jij niet onderaan een hiërarchie, maar naast collega’s die net als jij geloven in transparantie, autonomie en samenwerking. We delen kennis, stimuleren elkaars groei en vieren successen samen. Of dat nu op kantoor is, tijdens een kwartaalmeeting met een borrel, of op een projectlocatie waar jij impact maakt. En Het Mooiste? Je Staat Er Nooit Alleen Voor. Ons Employeneurship Model Is Uniek En Vanuit Dit Model Bieden Wij Jou: Je krijgt een vast contract, zodat je met vertrouwen kunt bouwen aan de toekomst; Je ontvangt een aantrekkelijk salaris (€4500 tot €6500), afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring; Je deelt mee in de winst, op basis van jouw persoonlijke prestaties – tot wel 45%; Je krijgt €2.200 opleidingsbudget per jaar, dat jij naar eigen inzicht mag besteden: van coaching tot vaktrainingen zoals Agile, BISL of DAMA DM-BOK; Je maakt deel uit van onze Business, IT & Data-cel, met ervaren en ondernemende collega’s; Je krijgt ruimte voor je eigen ideeën, via ons TMC Lab waar dromen realiteit worden; Je werkt aan projecten die ertoe doen, binnen de energietransitie, zorg, overheid, techniek en publieke dienstverlening.

description: Our mission is to provide innovative services critical to society, unlocking a cleaner, better and more profitable future. Success in this role means a deep, evidenced understanding of customer needs, a product strategy and roadmap clearly aligned with D&F's broader commercial strategy, and close collaboration with engineering, design, sales, and marketing to ship outcomes that strengthen Volue's market position. What you will be doing to make a difference: Develop a deep understanding of customers and the energy markets landscape – from balancing and trading through to long-term planning – including workflows, processes, and pain points; own product discovery and translate insights into product outcomes. Define product-specific strategy and business model, aligned with D&F's broader strategy and market opportunities across all time horizons. Maintain and prioritise the product roadmap based on customer discovery, commercial input, and technical feasibility. Ensure tight alignment with other products and business areas within Volue, collaborating extensively with Product Owners and other Product Managers across product lines, and with stakeholders in development, consulting, sales, and other functions to deliver a cohesive product offering and strategy. Own Go-To-Market alongside Sales and Marketing – plan launches, enable the field, close feedback loops from the market, and act as the market voice for the product, driving thought leadership and positioning Volue as a market leader in the segment. Monitor the competitive landscape and industry trends to keep products relevant and differentiated. Own and maintain key product assets for internal stakeholders – including the product roadmap, standard agreements and pricing, product factsheets, and presentations. Contribute to structured, systems-based ways of working within the D&F product team, reducing reliance on individual knowledge and coordination. What you need to succeed: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or commercial field, or equivalent relevant experience. 5+ years of experience working on software or data products as a product manager, product owner, consultant, or industry expert. Solid understanding of modern product discovery and product management practices. Language skills: fluent English required; additional European languages an advantage. Nice to have Proven experience in the energy, power markets, or trading industry. Comfort working with quantitative and forecasting concepts, and translating them into commercial and customer value. Personal skills Structured and self-starting, comfortable owning ambiguous problems. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills. Strong commercial understanding. Team-motivator with the ability to cooperate with a wide range of people and teams across functions and disciplines. Willing to travel as required by the role.
